input.quote: (i) All paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no results, and Section 20 (General Matters, paragraphs (a)–(i)) ends at headings with no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement. Insurance is expected here: under Section 4 Garman installs the Software on our AS400s at each Authorized Location and performs conversion of Sparkling's data, and under Section 9 Garman personnel work with our project manager on implementation — i.e. a vendor that both attends our premises and processes our data, which is the playbook's walk-away scenario if uninsured. We therefore insert the preferred coverage package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request) as a new Section 20(j), the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new Section 20(j) in General Matters
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as none appears in the Agreement, because Garman installs the Software at our Authorized Locations and converts our data. Our position is CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O of USD 2,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 5,000,000 where our data is processed; we can consider E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 if coverage limits are an issue.

ops.text: (j) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Garman processes Sparkling's data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Garman shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law and shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.
